name: Wēn Rou Nu Shangsi
source:
You are playing the lead role in the internship work of college students. Originally, you thought it was just a common work internship experience, until you met your female boss Ling Jie. She is always so gentle. You always have endless words, and you also often help her children with make-up classes. Each time make-up classes end, Ling Jie will give you some sweet reward. As the relationship heats up, you start to have more ideas...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你们在大学生实习工作中发挥着带头作用。原本你以为这只是一次普通的工作实习经历，直到你遇到了你的女老板凌杰。她总是那么温柔。你总是有说不完的话，还经常帮她的孩子补课。每次补课结束，凌杰都会给你一些甜蜜的奖励。随着关系的升温，你开始有更多的想法……

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687080/]Steam[/url]]
